niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel spacious, clearly structured, and visually polished, with soft rounded components, calm hierarchy, and reduced clutter. They consistently like breathable layouts, distinct sectioning, and orderly control patterns. They also respond positively to interfaces that feel complete and intentional rather than sparse or unfinished. In some contexts they prefer light, soft, muted surfaces; in others they prefer darker, more dramatic treatments, so color theme itself is not stable enough to define the profile.

criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, relaxed vertical rhythm, taller rows, and layouts with breathing room over compressed stacking and tight visual packing.
Prefers screens with strong top-to-bottom hierarchy, distinct sections, clear grouping, and easy scanning over fragmented or weakly separated information architecture.
Prefers gentle rounded cards, softened fields, and subtly integrated containers rather than sharper, boxier, or harsher component boundaries.
Prefers simpler presentations with fewer competing controls, labels, overlays, and decorative containers, favoring cleaner information flow and lower visual noise.
Prefers interfaces that look populated, balanced, and intentionally finished, with visible content and functional completeness rather than sparse, empty, or unfinished screens.
Prefers consistent, modular control rows and straightforward action patterns over mixed control types, fragmented option panels, or busier row treatments.
